g1.label: 1. Looking at a ___
g1.why: A screen is the display on a phone or computer; 'scream' and 'scene' don't fit.

g2.label: 2. Apps are ___ to keep users interested
g2.why: 'Designed to' means made on purpose for something.

g3.label: 3. Affect your ___ at school
g3.why: Concentration is your ability to focus, which too much screen time can affect.

g4.label: 4. Setting a daily ___
g4.why: A daily limit is the maximum time you allow yourself on an app.

g5.label: 5. Doctors also ___ putting your phone away
g5.why: 'Suggest' + -ing means to give advice; 'suspect' and 'support' don't fit.

g6.label: 6. A phone is just a ___
g6.why: A tool is something you use to do a job, so it depends on how you use it.

g1.label: 1. I really enjoy ___ videos
g1.why: 'Enjoy' is always followed by the -ing form.

g2.label: 2. She's trying to avoid ___ her phone

g3.label: 3. He keeps ___ track of time
g3.why: 'Keep' meaning 'continue' is followed by the -ing form.

g5.label: 5. Our teacher suggested ___ off notifications
g5.why: 'Suggest' is followed by the -ing form, not the to-infinitive.

g6.label: 6. Would you mind ___ the volume?
g6.why: 'Would you mind' is followed by the -ing form.

g8.label: 8. My brother gave up ___ that game
g8.why: 'Give up' is followed by the -ing form.

g7.label: 7. My parents refuse ___ me use my phone

g8.label: 8. We can't afford ___ how much time
g8.why: 'Can't afford' is followed by the to-infinitive.
